questions.q: What does Aleksa want to do in this video?
o: Take a photo on a film camera for Instagram
questions.e: In the video: "pokušaću da nađem film, da osmislim i napravim fotografiju, da taj film razvijem i dobijem fotku za Instagram" — I'll try to find film, come up with and take a photograph, develop that film and get a photo for Instagram.

questions.q: Whose cameras are these?
questions.e: In the video: "Ovo je fotoaparat mog dede. A ovo je fotoaparat mog pradede" — this is my grandfather's camera. And this is my great-grandfather's camera.

questions.q: What film did he choose, and why?
o: The cheapest black-and-white — there are no chemicals for developing color
questions.e: In the video: "nigde na internetu nisam našao hemikalije za razvijanje filma u boji. Pa sam išao na sigurno. Poručio sam najjeftiniji film" — nowhere on the internet did I find chemicals for developing color film. So I played it safe. I ordered the cheapest film.

questions.q: How much did the film cost?
questions.e: In the video: "On košta 1100 dinara, što je sa poštarinom oko hiljadu i po" — it costs 1100 dinars, which with postage is about fifteen hundred.

questions.q: What must not be done with film before developing?
questions.e: In the video: "sve dok ne razvijete film, on mora biti u potpunom mraku" — until you develop the film, it must be in complete darkness.

questions.q: Why did the author not dare to load the film for two days?
o: He was afraid of ruining it
questions.e: In the video: "mene je i dalje strah da ubacim ovaj film u kameru... strah me da će ceo film da ode u propast" — I'm still scared to put this film in the camera... I'm afraid the whole film will go to waste.

questions.q: How much does developing at a firm cost, and how much does home equipment cost?
questions.e: In the video: "sve ukupno bi mi izašlo oko sedam i po hiljada dinara... uslugu razvijanja filma. I to košta 690 dinara" — all together it would come to about seven and a half thousand dinars... a film developing service. And it costs 690 dinars.

questions.q: How did he colorize the black-and-white photographs?
questions.e: In the video: "Sajt se zove Palette.fm... čekate da AI odradi svoj posao" — the site is called Palette.fm... you wait for the AI to do its job.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Dok sam kopao po *starudijama*, naleteo sam na alatku.
questions.e: Starudija — an old thing, junk.

questions.q: Košta 1100 dinara, što je sa *poštarinom* oko hiljadu i po.
questions.e: Poštarina — the cost of shipping; pošta — mail.

questions.q: Kada pritisnemo *okidač*, otvara se rupa.
questions.e: Okidač — a trigger, a shutter button.

questions.q: Objektiv se sastoji od niza *sočiva*.
questions.e: Sočivo — a lens.

questions.q: Film se potapa u *razvijač*.
questions.e: Razvijač — a developer; razviti — to develop.

questions.q: Da li sam ja toliki *baksuz*?
questions.e: Baksuz — a loser, an unlucky person.

questions.q: Samo stisnete i *namotavate* u tom smeru.
questions.e: Namotati — to wind.

questions.q: U Photoshopu, kako bih tu sliku *izoštrio*.
questions.e: Izoštriti — to sharpen; oštar — sharp.

questions.q: Ovo je fotoaparat mog ___.
questions.e: Fotoaparat of whom? Genitive case: mog dede.

questions.q: Hteo sam da kupim film u ___.
questions.e: Film u boji — "color film", the locative case form.

questions.q: Nigde na ___ nisam našao hemikalije.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na internetu.

questions.q: Film je zapravo tanka, fleksibilna ___.
questions.e: The subject is in the nominative case: traka.

questions.q: Strah me da će ceo film da ode u ___.
questions.e: Ići u + accusative case; for feminine nouns ending in a consonant it coincides with the nominative: u propast.

questions.q: Sad ću Anđeli da pojasnim kako da koristi ovu ___.
questions.e: Koristiti what — accusative case: kameru.

questions.q: Ista firma ima i ___ razvijanja filma.
questions.e: Imati what — accusative case: uslugu.

questions.q: Sećate se kad sam na ___ videa rekao da neću stavljati crno-bele slike?
questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na početku.
